candidates.exact_span: The concentration in the sludge of each pollutant listed above in found in Element I, Section I, Table 1.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Cross-reference to Element I, Section I, Table 1 determines which pollutants and concentration values are subject to recordkeeping and, by incorporation into reporting item 6.d, to numeric limit comparison; ambiguous wording ('listed above in found in') could change which table or pollutant set is deemed applicable.

candidates.exact_span: The annual whole sludge application rate for the sewage sludge that does not cause the annual pollutant loading rates in Table 4 to be exceeded.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes an enforceable numeric constraint tied to Table 4 pollutant loading rates; interpretation of how the annual whole sludge application rate is calculated or compared to Table 4 limits could change which numeric limit applies and whether a reported rate exceeds it.

candidates.exact_span: List Pollutant Table 4 appropriate for permittee's land application practices.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Table 4 pollutant set applies depends on the permittee's land application practices; a different interpretation of 'appropriate' or of the underlying practices could change both the enforceable loading-rate limits evaluated under Purpose A and the annual reporting obligation under Purpose B.

candidates.exact_span: The frequency of monitoring listed in Element 1, Section I.C. which applies to the permittee.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Determines which monitoring-frequency requirements from Element 1, Section I.C. are actually applicable to the permittee; resolving 'which applies' could change whether monitoring was required for a given period or parameter.

Pass/Fail TCLP results function as a binary enforceable compliance criterion (Purpose A) and as a required annual DMR reporting item (Purpose B); interpretation of whether Pass/Fail is an enforceable limit versus report-only monitoring could change compliance evaluation.

candidates.exact_span: The concentration (mg/Kg) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 1 (defined as a monthly average) found in Element 1, Section I.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies the numeric parameter, units, averaging basis (monthly average), and source table for reported sludge pollutant concentrations; different interpretation of 'monthly average' or of the Element 1, Section I Table 1 cross-reference could change which limit applies and how reported measurements are compared.

candidates.exact_span: Class A pathogen reduction Alternative used as listed in Section I.B.3.a. Alternatives describe how the pathogen reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Identifies which pathogen-reduction alternative governs the permittee; interpretation of the selected alternative could change which monitoring or documentation was required (Purpose B) and what evidence state is established when numeric results are absent (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: Vector attraction reduction Alternative used as listed in Section I.B.4.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Identifies which vector-attraction-reduction alternative applies; resolving the applicable alternative could change required monitoring or documentation (Purpose B) and how missing or non-numeric evidence is classified (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: Annual sludge production in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes an annual reporting obligation for sludge production; whether this quantity was required and whether its absence constitutes missing required evidence or another no-data state could change Purpose B and Purpose C outcomes.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge land applied in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Required annual reporting of land-applied sludge quantity may condition applicability of land-application limits and Table 4 obligations; interpretation of whether land application occurred or was reported could change monitoring applicability (Purpose B) and missing-evidence classification (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge transported interstate in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a conditional annual reporting requirement tied to interstate transport; whether transport occurred and whether the report is present could change which obligations were applicable and how absent data are characterized.

candidates.exact_span: The following certification statement found in § 503.17(a)(6)(iii) shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: A required DMR-attached certification may constitute documentary evidence that management practices, pathogen, and vector-attraction requirements were met even without ordinary numeric results; interpretation of whether certification is present and sufficient could change missing-evidence semantics.
